_doc: THE IN-ORBIT LADDER READS THE STAMP, ONE SIGNED SHIFT OF RUNG 1 OF THE SOAK LADDER, ODQ §934.105 (the cloud chair signs by the owner's delegation of 2026-11-06, vetoable; a successor chair does not inherit this signature). THE CAUSE, ONE: LANDING-7 lane B's ruling R-B3 (commit 1f2a8504e, merged into the landing at 103b1db81): settlementLifecycleKernel.js :: advanceSettlementLifecycle's next-tier comparisons (thorp -> hamlet, the charter, the convergence fold) read TIER_STAMP_CUTS.hamlet / .village (25 / 88) instead of POPULATION_RANGES.hamlet.min / .village.min (20 / 75), X-46 car 2's law (the next tier's threshold is its stamp cut). THE MOVE, MEASURED at the landing tip 8e60cb2a5 before the write (the suite's own drive/goldenRow, the plain run red on 'reproduces every exact projection'): 4 of 4 rows move; founding ticks, plan ids, satellite ids and the lifecycle-only twin identical; the steading charters at the village cut 88 rather than 75, so it draws about 11-12 more settlers from Brimhold (final 8729/8733/8730/8733 -> 8718/8721/8718/8721) and demographic_migration receipts fall by 1-2 per seed (79/80/79/80 -> 78/78/78/78). Lane B's third seat reproduced the move byte for byte from the kernel diff alone applied at 8e568c729; the demographicsResponses re-base of the same ruling moves nothing here. Drafted unsigned by lane B's third seat (a seat does not sign); signed here under the chair's delegation as LANDING-7 lane E's brief directs. HOW: written at the branch tip (no later step follows it), the tree clean apart from the register, the manifest and this record. SECOND ACT, THE SAME FAMILY (the lifecycle under the stamp), signed under the same delegation and the same row: LANDING-7 ruling R-E8 (lane E's third seat): the lit demographic density ceilings follow the STAMP-band maxima. src/domain/worldPulse/demographicsRates.js :: DENSITY_CEILINGS, rule = old ceiling / old band maximum x stamp-band maximum (cut(next) - 1): thorp 90 -> 36, hamlet 600 -> 131, village 1,400 -> 543, town 7,500 -> 3,374, city 38,000 -> 22,798, metropolis 140,000 held (commits 20c0139c5, fecbdfd68, 020b9322b; a draft row in the tuning register). THE MOVE, MEASURED at 020b9322b before the write (the plain run red on 'reproduces every exact projection' and on nothing else; the non-vacuity, section-11b-shift and replay arms green): 4 of 4 rows move; founding ticks, plan ids, satellite ids and the lifecycle-only twin identical. Brimhold (a 9,500 'town' on plains) now stands at 2.45 of its 3,880-soul wall instead of 1.10 of 8,625, so it sheds harder to the village: final Brimhold 8718/8721/8718/8721 -> 7958/7969/7964/7956 and Farvale 883/885/887/885 -> 813/822/818/816; demographic_migration receipts 78/78/78/78 -> 160/150/160/160, demographic_step 152/147/141/152 -> 160/160/160/160, plans opened and closed 1 -> 2 per seed. HOW: written at the branch tip, the tree clean apart from the register, the manifest and this record. The generator golden master moves 0 of 525 rows (the ceilings are world-pulse only); the world-pulse goldens (deity, seasons, spatial), the lifecycle dormancy golden and the realm-scale certification are green unchanged.
